user.title: Connect to a Komari panel
user.description: Enter the panel root URL. You may also paste a URL ending in /api/rpc2.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty for a public panel.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Komari API key
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication failed for {url}. Enter a new API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Komari panel
reconfigure.description: Change the address or TLS verification setting. The API key is preserved.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Confirm panel address change
reconfigure_confirm.description: Change this logical panel from {old_url} to {new_url}? Existing devices and entities keep their identities.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Komari panel.
error.invalid_auth: The API key is missing, invalid, or does not have permission.
error.invalid_response: The panel returned an invalid RPC2 response.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS panel URL without user information, a query, or a fragment.
error.not_confirmed: Confirm the panel address change before saving.
error.unsupported_panel: This panel does not expose the RPC2 methods required by the integration.

abort.already_configured: This Komari panel is already configured.

monitoring.title: Monitoring intervals
monitoring.description: Choose polling intervals for this Komari panel only.

entities.title: Optional node entities
entities.description: Choose which metadata entities Home Assistant creates.

ping_tasks.title: Ping tasks
ping_tasks.description: Select up to 8 tasks. Newly discovered tasks are not selected automatically.

ping_stats.title: Ping statistics
ping_stats.description: Latest latency and packet loss are selected by default. Advanced statistics create additional entities.

metrics.title: Dynamic metrics
metrics.description: Select up to 8 retained custom metrics. Newly discovered metrics are not selected automatically.

metric_filters.title: Metric tag filters
metric_filters.description: Optionally enter exact tag filters as an object keyed by metric name. Invalid filters are never broadened into unfiltered queries.

metric_preview.title: Preview dynamic metrics
metric_preview.description: This selection can create up to {entity_count} dynamic metric entities. The per-panel limit is {entity_limit}.

metrics_unavailable.title: Dynamic metrics unavailable
metrics_unavailable.description: This panel does not currently expose both Metric RPC methods. Existing selections are preserved unless you explicitly clear them.

confirm.title: Confirm Komari options
confirm.description: Current assignments, discovered history and retained entities give an estimate of {entity_count} Ping entities. Missing discovery data leaves future counts unknown. The per-panel limit of {entity_limit} also applies to later discoveries.

error.too_many_ping_tasks: Select no more than 8 Ping tasks.
error.invalid_ping_task: One or more selected Ping tasks are no longer available.
error.ping_batch_unsupported: This panel cannot fetch the selected node and task matrix in one request. Select one task.
error.ping_stats_required: Select at least one Ping statistic.
error.invalid_ping_stat: One or more Ping statistics are invalid.
error.too_many_ping_entities: This selection exceeds the 256 Ping entity limit.
error.too_many_metrics: Select no more than 8 dynamic metrics.
error.invalid_metric_filter: One or more metric tag filters are invalid.
error.too_many_metric_entities: This selection exceeds the 128 dynamic metric entity limit.
error.metric_preview_failed: The panel could not preview the selected dynamic metrics. Check the filters and try again.

auth_failed.message: The Komari API key is invalid or no longer has permission.

update_failed.message: Unable to update data from the Komari panel.

selected_ping_task_missing.title: Selected Komari Ping tasks unavailable
selected_ping_task_missing.description: The Komari panel **{entry_title}** no longer lists {missing_count} of the selected Ping tasks. Remove them in the integration options or restore them on the panel.

ping_entity_limit_exceeded.title: Komari Ping entity limit exceeded
ping_entity_limit_exceeded.description: **{entry_title}** has {entity_count} retained or discovered Ping entity identities, above the per-panel limit of {entity_limit}. Disabled and historical entities also occupy slots. Reduce the selected tasks or statistics in the integration options. Existing identities are preserved; excess new entities are not created.

tls_verification_disabled.title: TLS certificate verification is disabled for Komari
tls_verification_disabled.description: The HTTPS connection for **{entry_title}** does not verify the server certificate. If this is not a temporary test setup, reconfigure the integration and enable TLS verification.

metric_capability_unavailable.title: Komari dynamic metrics unavailable
metric_capability_unavailable.description: The Komari panel **{entry_title}** does not currently expose both Metric RPC methods. Saved selections are retained and resume automatically when the capability returns.

selected_metric_missing.title: Selected Komari metrics unavailable
selected_metric_missing.description: The Komari panel **{entry_title}** no longer lists {missing_count} selected dynamic metrics. Restore them on the panel or remove them in the integration options.

metric_configuration_invalid.title: Komari dynamic metric configuration is invalid
metric_configuration_invalid.description: {invalid_count} saved dynamic metric selections or tag filters for **{entry_title}** are invalid. Invalid selections are disabled rather than queried without their filters. Review the integration options.

metric_entity_limit_exceeded.title: Komari dynamic metric entity limit exceeded
metric_entity_limit_exceeded.description: **{entry_title}** found {entity_count} dynamic metric entities, above the per-panel limit of {entity_limit}. Existing entities are kept first; excess entities are not created. Reduce the selected metrics or add tag filters.
